title: Digital Forensics Analyst
summary: A digital forensics analyst collects and examines evidence from computers, phones and storage devices to find out what happened in a cyber attack, fraud or legal dispute. You work in a forensics lab, a consulting firm's investigations team or a government cyber cell, and your reports may be used in court, so careful handling of evidence matters as much as technical skill.
dailyDuties: Make forensic images of laptops, drives and phones
Record chain of custody and verify hashes for every item
Analyse files, logs, browser history and chats with forensic tools
Extract data from mobile phones for investigators
Build timelines of user and attacker activity
Write forensic reports and evidence certificates
Brief lawyers, clients or investigators on findings

skills.expectation: Examine disks, memory and system artefacts to rebuild what happened
Image and analyse evidence with EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, AXIOM or Autopsy
Extract and analyse phone data with tools such as Cellebrite UFED
Keep chain of custody, hash every image and prepare court-ready evidence
Support breach and fraud investigations with the response team
Write clear forensic reports that hold up in legal review
Explain findings to lawyers, clients and investigators
Triage malicious files found during an examination
Research people and accounts from open sources
Read network logs and packet captures
Pull logs from SIEM tools for an investigation

certifications.why: Incident handling depth for corporate DFIR roles
Common entry security cert in Indian postings
Named as mandatory in some Indian forensics postings.
